conventions.bar_timestamp_basis: stored exchange event time; vendor receive-time aggregates can differ
conventions.bars: half-open clock buckets, one native instrument per row; empty buckets omitted
conventions.bbo: source depth-one fields retained with action/side; no additional depth or order identities reconstructed
conventions.coverage: computed observed values retained; completeness requires separate coverage evidence
conventions.executions: T only; B buy, A sell, N unknown; no event-value deduplication
conventions.ordering: equal timestamps remain unresolved unless source exchange sequence proves order
conventions.prices: native price units, exact decimal text in JSON

plan.coverage_basis: canonical file ownership and observed bounds
plan.coverage_note: An unowned interval may be a market closure or missing data; bounds alone do not decide this.
